name: Infra core: init, Luau evaluation to graph, validate
description: Milestone 1. infra init (scaffold, copy @infra stubs to .repo-infra/.luau, .luaurc), evaluate infra.luau into a side-effect-free graph with NuLua.Luau, sandbox (require only @infra and .repo-infra, no io/os), Output placeholders, --env and infra.env, validate command, --json/-v/--log plumbing and exit codes. Test: validate over demo/.repo-infra. See docs infra-cli/evaluation, infra-cli/commands and infra-cli/validation.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Design update: validate is runtime-only, no Luau type checking (NuLua.Luau has no analyzer). See docs infra-cli/validation.
